item.description:
XHelpers Pro 1.0.19 (37)
- AI Usage: a free ChatGPT plan shows a Free badge, its 30-day Codex window is labeled Monthly, and its billing reads "None (Free plan)" instead of Unavailable. When a Claude account's billing date has passed, the menu bar card offers "Check billing date", which reads the next one from claude.ai in Chrome. - Text Editor: the file browser takes multiple selections with Command- and Shift-click, and its context menu acts on the whole selection. - Text Editor, File Viewer, Markdown Preview and AI Settings windows now zoom or restore when you double-click anywhere on the title bar, not only along its top edge. - Updated translations in all 25 supported languages.
